justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/HasSuperTypeMatcher.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchers.java, byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/HasSuperTypeMatcherTest.java, and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/matcher/ElementMatchersTest.java. The class has limited fan-out: it stores one matcher and uses TypeDefinition/TypeDescription plus HashSet, Queue, Set, and QueueFactory in its traversal logic. Its fan-in is low: in production code it is instantiated only by ElementMatchers.hasGenericSuperType at lines 1987-1988, and the other references are confined to its dedicated test and one ElementMatchers test. That is not enough evidence of a dependency hub.
